description: List the crypto held in a Safe that can be sent out: balance (in the token's smallest unit), decimals, USD value where one can be found, and whether the token is allowlisted or merely discovered on LiFi's Base list. Covers the main account, vaults and joint accounts. Pass the returned contract address to initiate_crypto_send — never the symbol, because two tokens can claim the same one. `enabled: false` means crypto transfers are off for this account, which is not the same as holding nothing.

subAccountId.description: Vault or joint account to list. Omit for the main account's Safe.

name: list_sendable_crypto
